controls.title: Tenant authorization and Abracadabra policy enforcement
controls.acceptance: Documented negative cross-tenant access tests and approved authorization assertions

controls.title: Service identities and signed evidence authentication
controls.acceptance: Verify scoped tokens, signature freshness, issuer, audience and replay rejection

controls.title: Restricted operator access and access review
controls.acceptance: Document reviewer, decision, ticket reference and removed excess privileges

controls.title: Recoverability and tested backup restoration
controls.acceptance: Time-bounded restore drill with integrity validation and authorized reviewer

controls.title: Change and production release controls
controls.acceptance: Approved change, testing, release decision and rollback reference

controls.title: Third-party processing review
controls.acceptance: Vendor inventory, applicable DPA and approved risk decision

controls.title: Organization isolation for training and knowledge
controls.acceptance: Cross-org read/write tests deny access to knowledge, scripts, training sessions and results

controls.title: Encrypted session vault
controls.acceptance: Approved encryption/key scope and denial tests; secrets never sent as evidence

controls.title: Voice-session privacy and retention
controls.acceptance: Retention policy, deletion behavior and proof without audio/transcript disclosure

controls.title: External voice and AI processor governance
controls.acceptance: Deepgram/Cartesia/LLM configuration, retention settings and vendor review

controls.title: User invitation, least privilege and membership access
controls.acceptance: Verified role tests, invite controls and removal/access review

controls.title: AI credit and billing segregation
controls.acceptance: Credit receipts and tenant billing reconciliation without exposing financial records

controls.title: Deletion, backup and recovery policies
controls.acceptance: Completed recovery test, tenant-bound restore proof and retention review
